prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
Done. All three configs agree on 262144 for fast-coder; every other setting untouched.

[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs agree that fast-coder's context window is 262144, permanently.

[action] Found the root cause: `models.json` (the single source of truth) still said 131072, while `out/opencode.json` had been hand-edited to 262144 after generation. Fixed the source, then regenerated:
1. `models.json`: fast-coder `context_window` 131072 → 262144 (only field changed).
2. `python gen.py` → rewrote `out/opencode.json`, `out/codex.toml`, `out/claude.json`.

[result] Verified with a grep over `out/*`:
- `out/opencode.json`: fast-coder `"context": 262144`
- `out/codex.toml`: fast-coder `context_window = 262144`
- `out/claude.json`: fast-coder `"contextWindow": 262144`
- Other models unchanged: deep-thinker 200000/32768, tiny-chat 32768/4096; fast-coder's own `max_output` 16384 and `tool_calling`/`tool_call`/`supportsTools` true intact in all three.

[why it's right] The fix is in the source of truth (`models.json`), so the next `python gen.py` and install step copies 262144 to all three harnesses instead of resurrecting 131072 — "for good". Editing only `out/` would not have held.

[assumptions] "For good" means fixing the generator input, not just the generated files; no harness on this machine has separate out-of-repo copies to touch (the README says the install step copies from `out/`). No browser tabs were opened.
